source_snapshot.title: UAE fuel, diesel prices fall for November 2026
source_snapshot.text: ABU DHABI, 31st October, 2026 (WAM) -- The Gasoline and Diesel Prices Follow-up Committee approved the fuel prices for November 2026.Petrol prices fell by 5.6 percent, while diesel prices declined by 1.04 percent compared with October.The prices were approved under the UAE's monthly fuel pricing mechanism, which is based on global fuel price movements, with changes reflected in the domestic market.The approved prices are as follows:Super “98”: AED4.16 per litre. Special “95”: AED4.04 per litre.E-Plus “91”: AED3.97 per litre. Diesel: AED4.75 per litre.

title: UAE fuel, diesel prices fall for November 2026
summary_ru: 🚗 Цены на бензин и дизель в ОАЭ снизятся в ноябре 2026 💰 В ОАЭ утвердили новые цены на топливо на ноябрь 2026 года. Стоимость бензина упала на 5,6%, дизеля — на 1,04% по сравнению с октябрем. Новые цены: Супер 98 — 4,16 дирхамов за литр, Специальный 95 — 4,04 дирхамов, E-Plus 91 — 3,97 дирхамов, дизель — 4,75 дирхамов за литр.
